summary: ansible-galaxy role import github_user github_repo imports a role using your API token from ansible.cfg or --token, and by default waits and shows progress until done.
questions: How do I publish a role from GitHub to Galaxy?
How do I pass my Galaxy token on the command line?
What does a successful role import look like?

answer_card.title: Import a role to Galaxy
answer_card.answer_md:
Provide the token in `ansible.cfg` or with `--token`, then:
```bash
ansible-galaxy role import github_user github_repo
```
It waits for Galaxy to finish and prints progress (parsing `meta/main.yml`, README, tags as versions), ending with `Status SUCCESS`.
